# Data Clinic Recovery Software

> Data recovery software for Windows from Data Clinic Ltd, a UK data recovery company working since 2002. Software only on this site; the UK lab is at https://www.dataclinic.co.uk/.

## Products
- [Data Clinic Recovery for Hard Drives](https://www.dataclinic.com/hard-drive-recovery-software/): Windows 10/11 (64-bit). Hard drives, SSDs and USB sticks; reads NTFS, exFAT, FAT32 and Mac APFS, HFS+, HFS. Quick scan, deep scan, imaging, SMART health check before scanning, strictly read-only, Ask Rex AI assistant (optional, off by default). Free scan and preview; licences £39.99 (28 days), £69.99 (1 year), £149 (Business, 1 year). Current version 1.1.1.
- [Data Clinic Recovery for Memory Cards](https://www.dataclinic.com/memory-card-recovery-software/): free; SD and microSD cards (FAT32/exFAT); deep scan recognises 17 formats. Version 1.1.0.

## Honest limits
- Overwritten data cannot be recovered by any software.
- SSDs usually erase deleted files within minutes (TRIM); a quick format on an SSD erases the whole drive.
- Cannot read BitLocker, ReFS, Linux or FAT16 file systems, dynamic disks or RAID needing rebuild; never scans the drive Windows runs from.
- Physically failing drives (clicking, not detected, 0 MB) need a data recovery lab, not software.
